description: A schema requesting an attribute named function doesn't get the function property
notes: The spec says that processing a body in two steps is equivalent to one pass with the union of both schemas, and a schema with an attribute and a block type of the same name is an error, so asking for an attribute named function after the extension took the function blocks could be an error. hashicorp/hcl records the taken name in the remaining body's hidden attributes ((*body).PartialContent in json/structure.go), and processing that body skips every property with a hidden name (see json/bodies/partial-remain-attribute-not-a-later-block), so the attribute is absent.
